mapper.update: UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.is_top, a.is_featured, a.published_at, c.name AS category_name, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN article_tag art_tag ON art_tag.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = art_tag.tag_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.is_featured DESC, a.published_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM article a WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.cover_url, a.is_top, a.is_featured, a.view_count, a.published_at, c.name AS category_name, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN article_tag art_tag ON art_tag.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = art_tag.tag_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.is_top, a.is_featured, a.published_at, c.name AS category_name, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN article_tag art_tag ON art_tag.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = art_tag.tag_id WHERE a.category_id = #{categoryId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.is_featured DESC, a.published_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM article a WHERE a.category_id = #{categoryId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM article a JOIN article_tag filter_tag ON filter_tag.article_id = a.id AND filter_tag.tag_id = #{tagId} WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.is_top, a.is_featured, a.published_at, c.name AS category_name, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN article_tag art_tag ON art_tag.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = art_tag.tag_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.published_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.is_top, a.is_featured, a.published_at, c.name AS category_name, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN article_tag art_tag ON art_tag.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = art_tag.tag_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') ) ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.is_featured DESC, a.published_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN article_tag art_tag ON art_tag.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = art_tag.tag_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') )
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) FROM article WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1
